mentions.name: Quantra
mentions.description: Open source quantitative finance pricing platform built on top of QuantLib. It acts as a distributed QuantLib, exposing pricing, curve construction, and risk analytics through APIs so applications can integrate QuantLib functionality without dealing with the C++ library directly, adding an extra layer of abstraction on top of it.
mentions.problem: Integrating QuantLib into applications normally means dealing with the C++ library directly; the platform removes that friction by exposing QuantLib through APIs.
mentions.audience: Developers integrating QuantLib with their applications
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building an open source quantitative finance pricing platform built on top of QuantLib.

Think of it as a distributed QuantLib, exposing pricing, curve construction, risk analytics... through APIs, making QuantLib easy to integrate with applications without having to deal with the C++ library directly and an extra layer of abstraction on top of it.
mentions.author: melenaboija
